packages.name: dockpid
packages.author: doraorak
packages.description: dockpid is a lightweight tweak for macOS developers and power users that hooks into Dock.app to append real-time process IDs (PID) to running application tile labels. Includes configurable pill formatting, active process monitoring, and instant Dock reload support.
packages.shortDescription: Show live process IDs directly on Dock icons
packages.featuredDescription: Appends real-time process IDs (PIDs) directly to your macOS Dock tiles with customizable styles, live updates, and zero performance impact.

packages.name: PreferenceLoader
packages.author: doraorak
packages.description: PreferenceLoader brings the classic Theos / Cydia tweak settings architecture to macOS Sonoma and Sequoia System Settings. It dynamically discovers and injects third-party tweak configuration bundles into System Settings with native Apple controls, color pickers, sliders, and toggle switches.
packages.shortDescription: Native tweak preference pane & bundle loader for macOS Settings
packages.featuredDescription: The essential runtime engine that dynamically renders tweak preference bundles (PSSpecifier) directly inside macOS System Settings.
